name: Inquiry Pipeline Integration
description: Wire the inquiry step into the mesh routing pipeline in mesh/mesh.py. After a worker accepts a signal (stop-on-first-accept) and before consensus, call inquire() on the accepting worker. Thread the InquiryResult through to wherever assessment/consensus uses it. Ensure existing routing behavior is unchanged when inquiry produces no results. All existing tests must continue to pass.

types.name: InquiryConnection

fields.name: dimension
fields.description: The inquiry dimension this connection belongs to (e.g. 'people', 'projects', 'tickets', 'keywords', 'sentiment').

validators.error_message: dimension must be a non-empty string

fields.name: matched_item
fields.description: The item from the worker's context knowledge base that matched the signal dimension.

validators.error_message: matched_item must be a non-empty string

fields.name: score
fields.description: Relevance score of this connection, in the range [0.0, 1.0].

validators.error_message: score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: source
fields.description: Optional provenance label indicating where the matched_item was found (e.g. 'llm', 'embedding', 'keyword_overlap').

types.description: A single connection discovered during inquiry — links a matched item in a specific dimension back to a source in the worker's context knowledge base.

types.name: InquiryConnectionTuple
types.description: An immutable tuple of InquiryConnection items. Represented as a frozen tuple in the Pydantic model.

types.name: StringTuple
types.description: An immutable tuple of strings. Used for people, projects, tickets, keywords dimensions.

types.name: OptionalFloat
types.description: An optional float value. None means no value was produced.

types.name: OptionalInquiryResult
types.description: An optional InquiryResult. None means inquiry was not performed or not applicable.

types.name: InquiryResult

fields.name: people
fields.description: People entities extracted and matched from the signal.

fields.name: projects
fields.description: Project identifiers extracted and matched from the signal.

fields.name: tickets
fields.description: Ticket/issue identifiers extracted and matched from the signal.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Keywords extracted and matched from the signal.

fields.description: Sentiment score derived from the signal, in the range [-1.0, 1.0]. None if sentiment analysis was not performed.

validators.error_message: sentiment must be None or between -1.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: connections
fields.description: All connections discovered across dimensions during inquiry.

fields.name: confidence

validators.error_message: confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: worker_id
fields.description: Identifier of the worker that produced this inquiry result.

fields.name: signal_id
fields.description: Identifier of the signal that was inquired upon.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel capturing the full result of an inquiry step. Produced by a single accepting worker after signal decomposition and knowledge-base querying. All collection fields default to empty tuples, numeric fields to zero/None, and string fields to empty — so a default-constructed InquiryResult represents 'no findings'.

types.description: The full result of routing a signal through the mesh pipeline, now augmented with an optional InquiryResult.

types.name: InquiryStrategy

functions.name: inquire
functions.description: Decompose the given signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and query the accepting worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Uses LLM when available, falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. All errors are handled internally — this function NEVER raises. On any failure, returns a default-constructed (empty) InquiryResult with worker_id and signal_id populated.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The signal that was accepted by this worker in the stop-on-first-accept phase.

error_cases.name: llm_unavailable
error_cases.condition: LLM backend is not configured or unreachable

error_data.behavior: Falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. No exception propagated.

error_cases.name: knowledge_base_empty
error_cases.condition: The worker's context knowledge base contains no entries

error_data.behavior: Returns empty InquiryResult with confidence 0.0. No exception propagated.

error_cases.name: signal_decomposition_failure
error_cases.condition: Signal content cannot be decomposed into any dimensions

error_data.behavior: Returns empty InquiryResult with confidence 0.0. Logs warning. No exception propagated.

error_cases.name: unexpected_error
error_cases.condition: Any unexpected exception during inquiry processing

error_data.behavior: Catches all exceptions, logs error, returns default InquiryResult with worker_id and signal_id set.

preconditions: The worker has already accepted this signal (score above threshold) in the stop-on-first-accept phase
This method is called on the single accepting worker only
postconditions: Returned InquiryResult is a frozen Pydantic v2 model (immutable)
Returned InquiryResult.worker_id equals the calling worker's identifier
Returned InquiryResult.signal_id equals signal.id
Returned InquiryResult.confidence is in [0.0, 1.0]
Returned InquiryResult.sentiment is None or in [-1.0, 1.0]
All InquiryConnection.score values in connections are in [0.0, 1.0]
On any internal error, returns a default-constructed InquiryResult with worker_id and signal_id set and confidence == 0.0
Function never raises an exception
side_effects: May invoke LLM API calls (network I/O) when LLM backend is available
May compute embedding vectors (CPU/GPU) for similarity matching
Logs inquiry execution details at DEBUG level
Logs errors/warnings for internal failures at WARNING/ERROR level

functions.name: route_signal
functions.description: Route a signal through the mesh pipeline: broadcast to workers, stop on first accept, run inquiry on the accepting worker, then pass the optional InquiryResult into consensus/assessment. This is the modified top-level pipeline entry point in mesh/mesh.py. When inquiry_result is None or empty, downstream consensus/assessment behaves identically to the pre-inquiry implementation.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The signal to route through the mesh.

error_cases.name: no_worker_accepts
error_cases.condition: No worker scores above the acceptance threshold for this signal

error_data.signal_id: The signal ID that no worker accepted

error_cases.name: no_workers_registered
error_cases.condition: The mesh has no registered workers

error_data.detail: Cannot route signal: no workers registered in the mesh

error_cases.name: consensus_failure
error_cases.condition: Consensus/assessment phase fails after accept and inquiry

preconditions: At least one worker is registered in the mesh
postconditions: Returned RoutingResult.signal_id equals signal.id
Returned RoutingResult.accepted_by is a valid registered worker ID
If inquiry was performed, RoutingResult.inquiry_result is a frozen InquiryResult with matching signal_id and worker_id
If inquiry was not performed or failed, RoutingResult.inquiry_result is None
Consensus output is present in RoutingResult.consensus
Existing routing behavior (stop-on-first-accept, consensus) is unchanged when inquiry_result is None
All existing tests continue to pass without modification
side_effects: Broadcasts signal to all registered workers for scoring
Calls inquire() on the single accepting worker (after accept, before consensus)
Invokes consensus/assessment with optional inquiry_result parameter
Logs routing lifecycle events at INFO level

functions.name: run_consensus
functions.description: Execute the consensus/assessment phase, now accepting an optional InquiryResult. When inquiry_result is None, behavior is identical to the pre-inquiry implementation. When present, the inquiry data enriches the consensus assessment.

inputs.name: accept_result
inputs.description: The result of the stop-on-first-accept phase.

inputs.name: inquiry_result
inputs.description: Optional InquiryResult from the accepting worker. When None, consensus proceeds exactly as before the inquiry feature was added.

error_cases.name: invalid_accept_result
error_cases.condition: accept_result references a worker not registered in the mesh

error_data.detail: Accepting worker not found in mesh

preconditions: accept_result.worker_id is a non-empty string referencing a valid worker
If inquiry_result is not None, inquiry_result.signal_id == signal.id
If inquiry_result is not None, inquiry_result.worker_id == accept_result.worker_id
postconditions: Returned dict contains consensus assessment data
When inquiry_result is None, output is identical to pre-inquiry consensus behavior
When inquiry_result is provided, output may include enriched assessment data derived from inquiry connections
Function does not mutate any of its inputs
side_effects: May invoke assessment logic that reads worker state
Logs consensus computation details at DEBUG level

functions.name: create_empty_inquiry_result
functions.description: Factory function to create a default-constructed (empty) InquiryResult with only worker_id and signal_id populated. Used as the safe fallback when inquiry fails or is not applicable.

validators.error_message: worker_id must be a string (may be empty for unknown worker)
signal_id must be a string (may be empty for unknown signal)

postconditions: Returned InquiryResult.worker_id == worker_id
Returned InquiryResult.signal_id == signal_id
Returned InquiryResult.people == ()
Returned InquiryResult.projects == ()
Returned InquiryResult.tickets == ()
Returned InquiryResult.keywords == ()
Returned InquiryResult.sentiment is None
Returned InquiryResult.connections == ()
Returned InquiryResult.confidence == 0.0
Returned InquiryResult is frozen (immutable)

functions.name: validate_inquiry_result_frozen
functions.description: Contract test helper: verify that an InquiryResult instance is truly frozen (immutable). Attempts to set any field and confirms TypeError is raised. Used in contract tests to ensure the frozen invariant holds.

inputs.name: result
inputs.description: The InquiryResult instance to validate for immutability.

error_cases.name: not_frozen
error_cases.condition: The InquiryResult allows field mutation (not properly frozen)

error_data.detail: InquiryResult is not frozen — field mutation did not raise TypeError

preconditions: result is a valid InquiryResult instance
postconditions: Returns true if and only if the InquiryResult is frozen (all field mutations raise TypeError)
Does not mutate the input result

functions.name: validate_inquiry_result_serializable
functions.description: Contract test helper: verify that an InquiryResult instance can be serialized to JSON and deserialized back to an equivalent instance. Confirms round-trip fidelity.

inputs.name: result
inputs.description: The InquiryResult instance to validate for JSON serializability.

error_cases.name: serialization_failure
error_cases.condition: InquiryResult cannot be serialized to JSON

error_cases.name: deserialization_mismatch
error_cases.condition: Deserialized InquiryResult does not equal the original

error_data.detail: InquiryResult JSON round-trip produced a non-equivalent instance

preconditions: result is a valid InquiryResult instance
postconditions: Returns true if and only if JSON round-trip produces an equivalent InquiryResult
Does not mutate the input result

invariants: InquiryResult is always a frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel — no field may be mutated after construction
InquiryConnection is always a frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel — no field may be mutated after construction
inquire() NEVER raises an exception — all errors are caught internally and result in an empty InquiryResult
When inquiry_result is None, all downstream consensus/assessment behavior is identical to the pre-inquiry implementation
inquire() is called on exactly one worker: the single worker that accepted the signal in the stop-on-first-accept phase
inquire() is called AFTER stop-on-first-accept and BEFORE consensus/assessment
All existing mesh routing tests pass without modification after this integration
InquiryResult.sentiment is always None or in [-1.0, 1.0]
All InquiryConnection.score values are always in [0.0, 1.0]
InquiryResult is JSON-serializable and supports lossless round-trip serialization/deserialization
The inquiry_result parameter in consensus/assessment functions always defaults to None for backward compatibility
